title: Hollow Ivory
text: A ribcage the size of a chapel, half sunk in the ground, each rib as thick as a tower. Whatever wore it died long before there were Houses to remember it. The bone is hollow. From somewhere inside comes a deep, contented hum.

options.label: The deftest hands harvest the ivory, careful not to wake whatever hums inside.

outcomes.text: It comes away clean. All the way home it hums in the pack, louder whenever anyone tries to sleep.
The ivory comes away, along with whatever was sleeping inside it. It is not pleased to be woken.

options.label: Let the dead keep their bones. Whatever hums in there is content, and should stay so.

outcomes.text: The humming stops as you leave, as if it had been listening. Soon it starts again behind you, nearer now, keeping pace.
